'''Anril ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], Anril defected from the Empire and joined a rogue faction led by Major [[Korven]]. Operating from the [[Vanguard Station]], they began targeting and destroying nearby Alliance outposts. This eventually prompted the Alliance to retaliate and in defending the Vanguard Station against the assault, both Anril and Korven were killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Anril appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the final boss fight of "Fractured" Uprising.<ref name="SWTOR" />
